title: Nimble Slovak Sausage Skewers
description: A light, umami-packed dish of smoked fish sausage skewers flambéed in brandy, perfect for a date-night Slovakian-inspired dinner.
instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes to prevent burning.
In a bowl combine olive oil, minced garlic, chopped rosemary, lemon zest, smoked paprika, salt and pepper to make a seasoning paste.
Thread the smoked fish sausage slices onto the soaked skewers, spacing them evenly.
Brush each skewer with the seasoning paste, ensuring every piece is coated.
Preheat a grill pan over medium-high heat and grill the skewers for 3-4 minutes per side until lightly charred.
Transfer the grilled skewers to a heat-proof platter and drizzle with a little more olive oil.
Warm the brandy in a small saucepan, then carefully flame it with a long match, letting the alcohol burn off for 30 seconds.
Drizzle the flambé brandy over the skewers and garnish with fresh dill before serving.
